Spec says msg must not include referral line for unknown/missing codes. One-line fix suggested below — not applied (business logic).

minor.issue: Missing sa_id_number still returns 422 (Pydantic default) instead of 400 — carried over from iteration_32; not blocking, dealer UI validates client-side.

integration_issues.issue: Referred-by banner correctly hides when /api/referral/lookup returns 404, BUT the generated wa.me message still contains 'Referral code: ZZZZZZ' because `referralLine` is gated on referralCode alone. Fix: change /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx:73 from `const referralLine = referralCode ?` to `const referralLine = (referralCode && referrer) ?` so the message is consistent with the visible banner.

(Optional, carried over from iteration_32) Convert the 422 on missing sa_id_number to a 400 with a friendly message via an explicit Pydantic validator on AdminInviteUserRequest.

rca_of_issue: WhatsApp-referral-line-leak RCA: register.tsx has two independent guards. The banner JSX at line 122 is correctly `referralCode && referrer` (only shown when /api/referral/lookup succeeds). The WhatsApp `referralLine` at line 73 is only `referralCode ? ...` — so any string in the URL flows into the outgoing wa.me message. Reproduction: open /register?ref=ZZZZZZ, fill dealership + name, click 'Request via WhatsApp' → captured url contains encoded '• Referral code: ZZZZZZ'. Mitigation: change line 73 to `const referralLine = (referralCode && referrer) ? ...`. No backend change needed. Optionally also drop the '(from …)' clause since the banner already surfaces the referrer name.
